IllidanMasteryImmolationSweepingStrike.name: Immolation
IllidanMasteryImmolationSweepingStrike.description: After using Sweeping Strike, burn nearby enemies for 22 damage a second for 4 seconds.

IllidanMasteryBatteredAssaultSweepingStr.name: Battered Assault
IllidanMasteryBatteredAssaultSweepingStr.description: Increase Sweeping Strike's Basic Attack damage bonus duration from 3 to 5 seconds. If Sweeping Strike hits 2 Heroes its damage bonus is increased from 35% to 125%.

IllidanUnendingHatredPassive.name: Unending Hatred
IllidanUnendingHatredPassive.description: Quest: Minion kills grant 0.2 Basic Attack Damage. Hero Takedowns grant 1 Basic Attack Damage. Reward: After gaining 20 increased Basic Attack Damage, receive an additional 20 Basic Attack Damage.

IllidanReflexiveBlock.name: Reflexive Block
IllidanReflexiveBlock.description: Using Dive grants 75 Physical Armor against the next 3 Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

IllidanSweepingStrikesThirstingBlade.name: Thirsting Blade
IllidanSweepingStrikesThirstingBlade.description: Betrayer's Thirst's healing from Basic Attacks is increased from 30% to 50% while Sweeping Strike's damage bonus is active.

IllidanCombatStyleHuntersOnslaught.name: Hunter's Onslaught
IllidanCombatStyleHuntersOnslaught.description: Basic Abilities heal for 35% of the damage they deal. This bonus is doubled versus Heroes.

IllidanMasteryRapidChaseDive.name: Rapid Chase
IllidanMasteryRapidChaseDive.description: Dive grants 20% Movement Speed for 3 seconds. If the target is an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

IllidanMasteryFriendOrFoeDive.name: Friend or Foe
IllidanMasteryFriendOrFoeDive.description: Increases the range of Dive by 20% and allows it to be used to dive to allied Heroes.

IllidanMasteryUnboundSweepingStrike.name: Unbound
IllidanMasteryUnboundSweepingStrike.description: Sweeping Strike can go over walls and terrain. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes with Sweeping Strike, gain a second charge.

IllidanHeroicAbilityMetamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
IllidanHeroicAbilityMetamorphosis.description: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46 damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220 for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

IllidanHeroicAbilityTheHunt.name: The Hunt
IllidanHeroicAbilityTheHunt.description: Charge to target unit, dealing 251 damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

IllidanNimbleDefender.name: Nimble Defender
IllidanNimbleDefender.description: If Sweeping Strike hits an enemy Hero, gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

IllidanElusiveStrike.name: Elusive Strike
IllidanElusiveStrike.description: Sweeping Strike reduces the cooldown of Evasion by 3 seconds every time it damages an enemy Hero.

IllidanMasterySixthSenseEvasion.name: Sixth Sense
IllidanMasterySixthSenseEvasion.description: While active, Evasion grants Illidan 75 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 75%.

IllidanMasteryMarkedforDeathDive.name: Marked for Death
IllidanMasteryMarkedforDeathDive.description: Dive deals an extra 180 damage if used consecutively on a target within 10 seconds.

IllidanFieryBrand.name: Fiery Brand
IllidanFieryBrand.description: Every 3rd attack against the same Hero deals an additional 7% of their maximum Health as damage.

IllidanBladesOfAzzinoth.name: Blades of Azzinoth
IllidanBladesOfAzzinoth.description: Hitting 5 Heroes with Sweeping Strike allows Blades of Azzinoth to be activated, increasing Basic Attack damage by 75% for 8 seconds.

IllidanMasteryDemonicFormMetamorphosis.name: Demonic Form
IllidanMasteryDemonicFormMetamorphosis.description: Permanently remain in Demonic Form. Metamorphosis also increases Attack Speed by 20% and reduces the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows by 50%. Illidan can now mount in Demonic Form.

IllidanMasteryNowhereToHideTheHunt.name: Nowhere to Hide
IllidanMasteryNowhereToHideTheHunt.description: The Hunt gains unlimited range. Illidan passively reveals enemy Heroes below 25% Health anywhere on the Battleground.

GenericTalentNexusBlades.name: Nexus Blades
GenericTalentNexusBlades.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.name: Bolt of the Storm
GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.
